_comment: BEST-EFFORT: Cursor hook wiring. Cursor's hooks subsystem does not reliably surface additional_context emitted on SessionStart, so the UserPromptSubmit (inbox-notify) path is the reliable delta channel here. The shared session-start script already emits Cursor's additional_context shape, gated on CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT, which also locates the hook scripts; without it a hook fails rather than run a script from the session's directory.

hooks.command: "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:?basemind: the host set no plugin root}/hooks/run-hook.cmd" session-start
"${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:?basemind: the host set no plugin root}/hooks/run-hook.cmd" inbox-notify
